texts.Name: Anton Dziatkovskii
texts.How many years of industry experience do: 20+ (in industry since 2004; founder/BD since 2015; AI agents since 2023)
texts.Additional Information: Available immediately. Active US O-1 (no sponsorship needed now or in the future). Public proof of work: https://tonydzi.github.io/ and https://github.com/tonydzi - production multi-machine Claude fleet, published agent-fleet reliability evals (0/17 high-risk actions slipped past the human approval gate in recorded runs). 15+ years founder/BD: 10,000+ founder calls, enterprise advisory for subsidiaries of Foxconn and ANA Airlines - comfortable owning deployments in front of customers.
texts.What's the most interesting: Anthropic's Model Context Protocol documentation (the spec plus the connector guides) - not a glamorous pick, but it is the document I keep coming back to. I run a production multi-machine Claude fleet (6 machines, 100+ automation routines), and MCP is the layer where an agent demo becomes an agent that survives contact with real systems. Reading the spec closely changed how I structure connectors and evals in my own fleet (public repos: claw-consensus, verbatim-citation-gate). The deployment lesson: boring interface documentation, read carefully, beats another 'agents are the future' blog post.
